text:
Alice M.: Heads-up: Product will retire v1 SDK endpoints (generate/embed) on 2026-01-15. We need a short migration doc + two tiny examples (JS + Python) and a clear mapping table for users. I opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 :eyes:
Ben K.: Thanks. Can you list exact function name changes? Customers will search for exact replacements.
Alice M.: Sure. In the draft I have a simple mapping block: 
```
v1 -> v2
client.generate -> client.responses.create
client.embed -> client.embeddings.create
client.stream_generate -> client.stream.responses
tools -> functions (payload key)
model names: rwd-large-quant -> rwd-v2-large-q8
```
I'll turn that into a small table in the doc.
Carol R.: Please add a tiny Python example showing responses output shape (where text vs. function call results appear). That was the main support pain point last time.
Dave S.: Also note streaming behaviour: v2 streaming uses an async iterator from `client.stream.responses(...)` — show a short snippet.
Alice M.: Good. Draft snippets (will sanitize for docs):

// JS example (sync)
```js
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd-v2-large',
  input: 'Summarize the changelog in two bullets'
});
// generated text at res.output[0].content[0].text
console.log(res.output[0].content[0].text);
```

# Python example (sync)
```py
res = client.responses.create(
  model='rwd-v2-large',
  input='Summarize the changelog in two bullets'
)
# generated string: res.output[0].content[0].text
print(res.output[0].content[0].text)
```

// streaming JS snippet
```js
for await (const chunk of client.stream.responses({ model: 'rwd-v2-large', input: prompt })) {
  // chunk.delta contains partial text
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```

Ben K.: Nice. One note: the responses output shape varies if a function was called; include that tiny example: `res.output` may contain an entry with `type: 'tool_call'` and payload under `content[].function_result` or similar.
Alice M.: Added a short diff example for tools -> functions: 
```
// v1 payload
{ tools: [{ name: 'search', args: {...} }], input: 'Find rate limits' }

// v2 payload
{ functions: [{ name: 'search', arguments: {...} }], input: 'Find rate limits' }
```
Carol R.: Finance wants a one-paragraph billing note: v2 bills per-subtoken, and rounding changed (they round up per-subtoken). Also link to pricing page. Put it under "Billing & compatibility".
Alice M.: Will do. Also adding this one-liner at the top: "If you need more time to migrate, open a support ticket or contact your CSM to request extended access." Saves triage.
Dave S.: CI flakiness: examples should use short timeouts and not call real models in tests. Use mocked responses in the e2e example or the `REDACTED_FAKE` model.
Alice M.: Good call — I'll add a note and a tiny mocked example snippet.
DocsBot: PR draft created by @alicem in redwood-inference/docs (#1301) — reviewers requested: @benk, @carolr
Ben K.: I'll review later today. Watch wording around model renames; some customers use custom naming mapping, so make the table advisory not prescriptive.
Carol R.: Reviewed and left two comments about the streaming section and billing phrasing.
Alice M.: Addressed Carol's comments and pushed updates. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301/files

Alice M.: Merging after CI green. Will post an announcement in #announcements and ping support. Thanks all :tada:
